text:
Situation: Nitrofurantoin 50 mg capsules are not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 353 capsules (25.7 days on hand at 13.7 per day). Corvale General holds 409 capsules (25.7 days on hand at 15.9 per day). Corvale Lakeside holds 29 capsules (11.4 days on hand).

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include nitrofurantoin as of 2026-10-21. The rule-based alternate manufacturer ranked first is Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited, which is not on FDA's shortage list today. Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited is named on label a8a0d7d7 as the plant for NDC 62332039031 with FEI 3004956904 in India. Its last inspection was classified NAI on 2024-07-26. FDA inspection records for that FEI show multiple VAI classifications from 2010 through 2020, with the most recent VAI inspection ending 2020-03-13 and known on 2020-06-11.

Our position: Current inventory at East and General provides approximately 26 days of supply. Lakeside inventory is lower at 11.4 days. No FDA shortage listing exists. Alternate manufacturers are available and not on the shortage list. Alembic's plant has a recent NAI classification but a history of VAI findings.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer verifies current supply availability and lead times from Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited; buyer approves purchase order if terms are acceptable.
2. Buyer verifies supply availability from Amneal Pharmaceuticals of New York LLC, Aurobindo Pharma Limited, AvPAK, and BluePoint Laboratories as backup sources; buyer approves purchase orders.
3. Buyer monitors FDA inspection updates for FEI 3004956904 and reports any classification changes to the P&T committee; P&T committee chair approves escalation if supply risk increases.
4. Buyer coordinates with Corvale Lakeside pharmacy to transfer stock from East or General if days on hand fall below 14 days; pharmacy directors at both sites approve transfer.

Not recommended: Initiating therapeutic alternatives or formulary changes at this time; clinical decisions remain with treating clinicians and the committee.
